description: This file defines the UriResolver class which provides static methods for resolving and relativizing URIs in accordance with RFC 3986. It handles path normalization, resolution against base URIs, and creating relative URIs.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to resolve and relativize URIs according to RFC 3986 standards.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments ('..' and '.') from a URI path, normalizing it.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, producing a new absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Returns a relative URI from a base URI to a target URI.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Computes the relative path from a base URI to a target URI.
